metadata.description: Must match the 'NotifySocTeams' logical name in Function/Modules/RunPlaybookModule/PlaybookAllowList.psd1 - the trigger URL of the deployed workflow is what gets stored (via Key Vault) under that allow-list entry.
Subscription ID containing the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace.
Resource group containing the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace.
Name of the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace to query for PIM and activity detail.
SOC distribution list / mailbox that receives the Global Administrator usage notification email.

UPN of the mailbox the notification is sent from via the Office 365 Outlook 'Send an email (V2)' connector action. The playbook authenticates that connector call with its own system-assigned managed identity (authentication: ManagedServiceIdentity) rather than a signed-in user's stored OAuth credential - see README.md for how the office365 connection needs to be authorized.
How far back/forward around the Global Administrator activation to look for activity performed by the account. Align with your PIM policy's maximum activation duration.

body.query:
let TargetRequestId = '@{outputs('Parse_GA_Alert_Details')?['RequestId']}';
let TargetUser = '@{outputs('Parse_GA_Alert_Details')?['GlobalAdminAccount']}';
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
| where Category == "RoleManagement"
| mv-expand TargetResources
| where TargetResources.type == "Role"
| mv-expand ModifiedProperty = TargetResources.modifiedProperties
| where ModifiedProperty.displayName == "Role.DisplayName"
| where tostring(ModifiedProperty.newValue) has "Global Administrator"
| mv-expand AdditionalDetail = AdditionalDetails
| extend DetailKey = tostring(AdditionalDetail.key), DetailValue = tostring(AdditionalDetail.value)
| summarize AdditionalMap = make_bag(pack(DetailKey, DetailValue))
    by TimeGenerated, OperationName, Result,
       RowTargetUser = tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName),
       Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend RequestId = tostring(AdditionalMap.RequestId)
| extend Justification = tostring(coalesce(AdditionalMap.Justification, AdditionalMap.RoleAssignmentJustification))
| extend TicketNumber = tostring(AdditionalMap.TicketNumber)
| where (isnotempty(TargetRequestId) and RequestId == TargetRequestId) or RowTargetUser =~ TargetUser
| summarize
    RequestedBy   = anyif(Actor, OperationName has "requested" or OperationName has "activate"),
    ApprovedBy    = anyif(Actor, OperationName has "approved"),
    ActivatedAt   = minif(TimeGenerated, OperationName has "completed" or OperationName has "activation" or OperationName == "Add member to role"),
    Justification = anyif(Justification, isnotempty(Justification)),
    TicketNumber  = anyif(TicketNumber, isnotempty(TicketNumber))
    by RequestId, RowTargetUser

let TargetUser = '@{outputs('Parse_GA_Alert_Details')?['GlobalAdminAccount']}';
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(@{parameters('ActivationWindowHours')}h)
| where tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName) =~ TargetUser
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Category, Result,
    Target = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
    TargetType = tostring(TargetResources[0].type)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| take 200

Compose_Email_Body.inputs:
Global Administrator role usage

FieldValue
Account elevated to Global Administrator@{outputs('Parse_GA_Alert_Details')?['GlobalAdminAccount']}
Activation type@{outputs('Parse_GA_Alert_Details')?['ActivationType']}
Requested by@{coalesce(body('Get_PIM_Request_Details')?['value']?[0]?['tables']?[0]?['rows']?[0]?[0], outputs('Parse_GA_Alert_Details')?['RequestingOrActivatingActor'], 'Unknown')}
Approved by@{coalesce(body('Get_PIM_Request_Details')?['value']?[0]?['tables']?[0]?['rows']?[0]?[1], 'Self-activation / no approval on record')}
Activated at (UTC)@{coalesce(body('Get_PIM_Request_Details')?['value']?[0]?['tables']?[0]?['rows']?[0]?[2], 'Unknown')}
Justification@{coalesce(body('Get_PIM_Request_Details')?['value']?[0]?['tables']?[0]?['rows']?[0]?[3], 'None recorded')}
Ticket number@{coalesce(body('Get_PIM_Request_Details')?['value']?[0]?['tables']?[0]?['rows']?[0]?[4], 'None recorded')}
Sentinel incident@{triggerBody()?['IncidentARMId']}

Activities performed by this account (@{parameters('ActivationWindowHours')}h window)

Row count: @{length(body('Get_GA_Activities_Performed')?['value']?[0]?['tables']?[0]?['rows'])} - see the attached Sentinel incident / run this playbook's query directly in Log Analytics for the full, unabridged list.

body.Subject: @{concat('SOC ALERT: Global Administrator role used by ', outputs('Parse_GA_Alert_Details')?['GlobalAdminAccount'])}

body.message: @{concat('NotifySocTeams: SOC notified by email at ', parameters('SocTeamEmail'), ' with Global Administrator PIM/assignment detail for ', outputs('Parse_GA_Alert_Details')?['GlobalAdminAccount'], '.')}
